6.393 rsInvalidRelationshipDuplicateParentScope
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsInvalidRelationshipDuplicateParentScope is a critical error that occurs when multiple Relationship
elements on the same intersection scope have the same value for Relationship.ParentScope.
